title: Authoritative observed-deployment inventory in Settings
intent: Show Bahia's signed, authoritative inventory of deployments per environment (desired vs observed, health, drift, freshness, instances) in Settings, with stale, unavailable, desired-only, observed-only and unmanaged coverage explicit, and keep build provenance structurally and visually separate.
supersedes: The 2026-08 observed_deployments array embedded in bahia.system-discovery.v1 (commit 18a5079a), rejected by review review-fp-bahia-settings-observed-deployments-20260927.

entities.environment-inventory: d=deployment-inventory:environment:<environment_id>; complete snapshot; tombstoned with deleted=true on environment deletion

projection.freshness: stale_after_seconds = projector repair interval + 2 x reconcile interval; consumers judge staleness from observed_at/scanned_at

security.allowlist: image refs, labels, codes and sha256 digests only; no hosts, container IDs, env values, commands, mounts, labels, free-form failure messages
security.unmanaged_exposure: Owner decision option B: public aggregates only; per-instance detail only via authorized NIP-59 wrapped adoption/scan
security.audit: runtime.observation 4903 audit reduced to an allowlisted summary

compatibility: No new kind. bahia.system-discovery.v1 no longer carries observed_deployments; discovery-only clients keep working without deployment rows. adoption/scan and adoption/import now require NIP-59 wrapped requests.
